title: Robot Dog Idle
prompt: A friendly cartoon robot dog sits on a checkered floor: boxy body, round eyes on a screen face, antenna ears. It breathes, tilts its head and wags a spring tail in a loop.
description: Rig a sitting robot dog with nested pivots, colored toon bands and loop-safe secondary motion.
